bpm_buckets.character: Amen Velocity / Liquid Chrome — complex syncopated breakbeat (amen/think-break style); Reese bass dominant; fast sidechain; wide pads against strict mono kick/bass

kick.name: Kick
kick.role: Breakbeat anchor — syncopated position within the 2-bar amen pattern

effect_chain.params: 18 Hz, 24 dB/oct Butterworth
Attack +6 dB (0-5 ms), Sustain -4 dB (50-200 ms) — tight, fast, maximum punch at high BPM
Ratio 4:1, Thr -12 dBFS, Attack 5 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.5, Knee 2 dB, GR 3-5 dB
Drive +3 dB, Mix 100%, 2nd+3rd harmonic bias, Target THD 4-6% — subtle, preserves tight transient
Bell -3 dB @350 Hz Q=1.4; Bell +2 dB @58 Hz Q=1.2; Bell +1.5 dB @4 kHz Q=2.0
Ceiling -1.0 dBTP, Lookahead 1.5 ms

bass.name: Bass
bass.role: Reese bass — heavily detuned, modulated growl; mono below 120 Hz, stereo movement above

effect_chain.params: 28 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Ratio 6:1, Thr -15 dBFS, Attack 1 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.75 (dotted-8th), GR 5-7 dB — very fast sidechain at 170+ BPM
Drive +4 dB, Mix 100%, Target THD 8-12%, pre-EQ position — Reese growl harmonics
Bell -2.5 dB @250 Hz Q=1.2; Low shelf +1.5 dB below 60 Hz; Bell +3 dB @150 Hz Q=2.0 (Reese body)
Ratio 3:1, Thr -10 dBFS, Attack 10 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×2, GR 2-3 dB
Mono enforced below 120 Hz (M/S split); stereo movement from detuned oscillators preserved above 120 Hz; Ceiling -8 dBFS
LP cutoff swept 200 Hz -> 2 kHz to create Reese growl movement, tempo-synced or manually automated

chords.name: Chords
chords.role: Harmonic support — dark minor/dorian voicings, stabs or sustained pads

effect_chain.params: 150 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Bell -2 dB @800 Hz Q=1.0; Bell -2 dB @350 Hz Q=1.2
Ratio 2.5:1, Thr -14 dBFS, Attack 15 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×1 (quarter note), GR 2-3 dB
Width ±20% — narrow, keeps harmonic bed mono-compatible
RT60 2.2 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/16, HPF 300 Hz, LPF 7 kHz, Mix 18% wet
-1.5 dB low shelf @250 Hz; Ceiling -10 dBFS

melody.name: Melody
melody.role: Lead line — synth lead or sampled vocal chop, fast and rhythmically active

effect_chain.params: 200 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Presence bell +2 dB @3.2 kHz Q=1.8; Bell -2 dB @600 Hz Q=1.5
Ratio 3:1, Thr -13 dBFS, Attack 8 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.75, GR 3-5 dB
Time = 60000/BPM×0.75 (dotted 8th), Feedback 22%, Mix 14%, HPF 400 Hz — shorter feedback to prevent wash at 170 BPM
RT60 1.0 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/16, HPF 500 Hz, LPF 8 kHz, Mix 12%
+1.5 dB high shelf @10 kHz; Ceiling -8 dBFS

arp.name: Arp
arp.role: 16th-note or 32nd-note synth run — defines DnB's rapid subdivision energy

effect_chain.params: 300 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Attack +3 dB, Sustain -4 dB — crisp notes at extreme tempo
Ratio 4:1, Thr -16 dBFS, Attack 2 ms, Release = 60000/BPM/2, GR 3-4 dB
Time = 60000/BPM/4 (16th note = ~87 ms at 172 BPM), Feedback 25%, Mix 18%, HPF 600 Hz — tighter feedback at high BPM
RT60 0.4 s, Pre-delay 5 ms, HPF 1 kHz, Mix 8%
Width ±60-80% above 500 Hz, mono below 300 Hz; Ceiling -8 dBFS

pads.name: Pads
pads.role: Wide spatial bed — liquid DnB atmosphere; maximum stereo width above 250 Hz

effect_chain.params: 220 Hz, 6 dB/oct
Ratio 2:1, Thr -18 dBFS, Attack 30 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×4, GR 2-3 dB
Width ±80-100% — full stereo width; contrast with mono kick/bass below
RT60 3.5 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/8, HPF 300 Hz, Mix 28%
Ratio 3:1, Thr -22 dBFS, Attack 3 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.75, GR 3-4 dB — fast sidechain at 170 BPM
Width 150% above 300 Hz, Correlation floor +0.2; Output limiter -12 dBFS

stabs.name: Stabs
stabs.owns: Mid 500 Hz-2 kHz + High-mid 2-6 kHz transients
stabs.role: Rhythmic punctuation — synth stab or chopped sample, dense hit

effect_chain.params: 250 Hz, 12 dB/oct
Attack +5 dB, Sustain -5 dB
Ratio 5:1, Thr -14 dBFS, Attack 3 ms, Release = 60000/BPM×0.5, GR 5-7 dB
Drive +3 dB, Mix 45%, H2/H3 dominant
RT60 0.5 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/16, HPF 500 Hz, Mix 8%
+2 dB @1.8 kHz Q=1.6; -2.5 dB @400 Hz Q=2.0; Ceiling -7 dBFS

fx.name: FX
fx.owns: Air 6-20 kHz + broadband sweeps + resampled breaks
fx.role: Transition & tension — risers, impacts, break-section atmosphere

effect_chain.params: Swept 20 Hz -> 2 kHz over riser duration, 12 dB/oct
Width ramps ±40% -> ±100%
Time = 60000/BPM×0.75 (dotted 8th = ~261 ms at 172 BPM), Feedback 38%, Mix 28%
RT60 5.0 s, Pre-delay 0 ms, HPF 500 Hz, Mix 40%, freeze on last 1/4
Ceiling -1.5 dBTP; LPF 16 kHz 12 dB/oct

percussion.name: Percussion
percussion.role: Breakbeat elements — snare, ghost notes, hi-hats; Amen/Think break-style syncopation

effect_chain.params: 500 Hz, 18 dB/oct
Attack +2 dB, Sustain -3 dB — tight attack at 170 BPM
Ratio 3:1, Thr -17 dBFS, Attack 1 ms, Release = 60000/BPM/4 (16th note = ~87 ms at 172 BPM), GR 2-3 dB
-3 dB @6.3 kHz Q=2.5; +2.5 dB @12 kHz shelf; -2 dB @900 Hz Q=1.2
Width ±50%
RT60 0.3 s, Pre-delay 4 ms, HPF 1 kHz, Mix 10%
Ceiling -8 dBFS

intro.name: Intro
intro.owns: First 4 bars, minimal density, rapid build
intro.role: Tight 4-bar intro — DnB builds fast; bass then drums slam in immediately

effect_chain.params: Starts at 800 Hz, sweeps down to 40 Hz over 4-bar intro, 6 dB/oct
RT60 3.5 s, Pre-delay = 60000/BPM/8, HPF 300 Hz, Mix 30%
Width ramps ±60% -> ±100% across 4-bar intro
Slow LP sweep, Rate = 1/(4 bars × 60/BPM×4) Hz
-18 dB -> 0 dB S-curve over 4 bars (entry order: Bass -> Kick -> Hi-hat/Percussion -> Pads)
Ceiling -14 dBFS

drum.chain: EQ -> Comp (glue 2:1) -> Saturation (tape, low drive) -> Limiter (-3 dBTP)

bass.chain: HPF (28 Hz) -> Comp (glue 3:1) -> M/S mono-izer (<120 Hz) -> Saturation (transistor)

synth.chain: EQ (carve) -> Comp (bus glue 2:1) -> Stereo widener -> Saturation (light, optional)

fx.chain: EQ (notch low-end) -> Delay/Reverb sends -> Limiter (-1.5 dBTP)

master.chain: Bus EQ (±1.5 dB max) -> Multiband glue comp (1.5:1) -> M/S mastering EQ -> True-peak limiter

sidechain_routing.release_formula: 60000/BPM×0.75 (dotted-8th — faster than usual for DnB tempo)

parallel_compression.reasoning: DnB requires 45-60% wet blend with 1-3 ms attack and 30-60 ms release (per PDF spec); very fast release is mandatory at 170+ BPM to recover gain in time for the next 16th-note subdivision without audible pumping between breakbeat ghost notes.

kick.exclusive_claim: 50-65 Hz peak (breakbeat kick sits tighter than trap); no boost elsewhere.

bass.exclusive_claim: 30-200 Hz; Reese growl harmonics extend to 500 Hz; strictly mono below 120 Hz.

chords.exclusive_claim: 250-500 Hz; root above 250 Hz; yield to Reese bass upper harmonics below 300 Hz.

melody.exclusive_claim: 800 Hz-2 kHz; priority claim; fast, rhythmically active melodic line.

arp.exclusive_claim: 2-6 kHz rapid sequence; notched -3 dB at melody presence peak.

pads.exclusive_claim: Wide stereo side channel; mid deeply scooped at 1-2 kHz; complements mono bass.

stabs.exclusive_claim: Time-sliced: <15% duty cycle; fast attack events in breakbeat gaps.

fx.exclusive_claim: Above 6 kHz; break resamples; never simultaneous with riser at section joins.

percussion.exclusive_claim: Amen/Think breakbeat components; snares 1-4 kHz, hats 4+ kHz; ghost notes micro-timed.

intro.exclusive_claim: First 4 bars only; very fast transition to full arrangement.

streaming.notes: DnB PLR target 7-9 dB; preserve transient punch of the breakbeat — over-limiting at -14 LUFS destroys the snare crack that defines the genre.

broadcast.notes: EBU R128 ±0.5 LU. Mono-check kick/bass rigorously; wide pad stereo must not cause mono cancellation below 200 Hz. Check Reese bass mono compatibility.

sync_licensing.notes: Stems mandatory. Separate breakbeat, bass, and synth stems. Deliver Reese bass stem dry + wet separately if possible. Leave dynamic range.

branches.kick_desc: Pure sine sub kick, minimal harmonics, instant attack, sub register

bass.avoid: B2+ (centroid drifts into kick critical band)

branches.kick_desc: Analog-modeled kick with moderate harmonic density, instant attack, bass register

bass.avoid: B1-B3 D2-D3 (intermodulation with kick D2; critical with Reese bass D2)

melody.avoid: D3 (masking risk with kick D2 + Reese D2)

arp.avoid: D2+ (accumulation risk with kick D2 and bass D2)

branches.kick_desc: Dark, slow-attack sub kick — rare in DnB; used only for half-time or intro sections

bass.avoid: any A0 R0 (Haas fusion collision; especially dangerous with Reese bass fast onset)

arp.avoid: R0-R1; also avoid A0 if bass is A0 (onset collision)
